Repository builds `vis42.mcpb`, a Claude Desktop MCP Bundle containing a Node.js stdio-to-HTTP proxy forwarding to `https://vis42.com/api/mcp`. Specs: [MCPB MANIFEST.md](https://github.com/anthropics/mcpb/blob/main/MANIFEST.md) | [Architecture overview](https://github.com/anthropics/mcpb/blob/main/README.md).

The proxy must answer Claude Desktop's `initialize` immediately. Remote connection is deferred: connect lazily on first request; reuse `remoteClient` or `connectPromise`, and await `getRemoteClient()` in request handlers. Never block in startup with `await connectToRemote(); // this will timeout Claude Desktop`.

Transport **constructors never throw**. Errors surface only when `client.connect()` is awaited. The SSE fallback must wrap the `connect()` call: construct `StreamableHTTPClientTransport`, await `client.connect(transport)`; on failure log `StreamableHTTP failed (${err.message}), retrying with SSE...`, construct `SSEClientTransport`, then await `client.connect(sseTransport)` and let it throw naturally if SSE also fails.

All log output must go to `stderr`. `stdout` is the MCP protocol channel. Use `process.stderr.write(`[vis42-proxy] ${msg}\n`)`; never use `console.log` for debug output.

Tools are stripped to `{ name, description }` only. The upstream payload includes runtime hints that must not appear in the manifest. Prompts’ manifest `arguments` are string names, not objects: map `p.arguments` to `a.name`.

`resources` is **not a valid manifest field**. The pack validator rejects it. Skip resources in the manifest; `resourceCount = rawResources.length` may be logged only. Resources are handled at runtime by the proxy's existing `resources/list`, `resources/read`, and `resources/templates/list` handlers.

GitHub Actions `toJSON()` produces `"null"` for absent fields: use `const raw = JSON.parse(process.env.SOME_JSON || 'null') || [];`, not `JSON.parse(process.env.SOME_JSON)`.

Use `env:` variables for all payload data. Never interpolate `client_payload` fields directly in `run:` scripts. Example: `DATA: ${{ toJSON(github.event.client_payload.tools) }}` then `run: node -e "const data = JSON.parse(process.env.DATA); ..."`.

Manifest:
- `manifest_version`: `"0.3"` (manual). Do not change.
- `name`: string (manual machine-readable ID); `version`: CI, synced with `server/package.json`.
- `tools`: `{name, description}[]` (CI, stripped upstream); `promp
